agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting reviewed and approved the business feasibility study reports from KJPP Wawat Jatmika & Rekan regarding proposed changes to the company's business activities.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the addition of five retail business categories and the amendment of Article 3 of the Articles of Association to reflect these changes.
Agenda #3: The meeting approved the feasibility study reports from KJPP Wawat Jatmika & Rekan regarding business activity changes for the subsidiary PT Parit Padang Global.
Agenda #4: Shareholders approved adding E-commerce and Digital Platform activities to the business scope of PT Parit Padang Global, subject to further formal approval by the subsidiary.
Agenda #5: The meeting accepted feasibility study reports confirming that the proposed business expansion plans for the subsidiary PT Soho Industri Pharmasi are feasible.
Agenda #6: Approval was granted for PT Soho Industri Pharmasi to add traditional medicine raw material industry and warehousing activities to its business scope.
Agenda #7: The meeting approved the appointment of Ignasius Jonan as President Commissioner and Independent Commissioner, while Eng Liang Tan transitioned to a Commissioner role.
Agenda #8: The meeting confirmed the composition of the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners, including the appointment of Ery Yunasri as President Director.
Agenda #9: The Board of Directors was granted the authority and power of attorney to implement all meeting decisions, including notarizing acts and notifying the Ministry of Law.

agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited Consolidated Financial Statements, granting a full discharge of liability to the Board of Commissioners and Directors for the 2025 fiscal year.
Agenda #2: Shareholders established the 2025 net profit at Rp600.3 billion and approved a total cash dividend of Rp39.5 per share, totaling IDR 501,321,454,405. The distribution includes the ratification of interim dividends and is scheduled for payment by June 18, 2026.
Agenda #3: The meeting approved the appointment of Benediktio Salim, CPA and KAP Purwanto Susanti dan Surja to audit the 2026 fiscal year financial statements.
Agenda #4: Authority was granted to the Board of Commissioners to determine salaries and honoraria for both the Board and Directors, considering recommendations from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
Agenda #5: The meeting addressed the composition and terms of office for commissioners Harry Salam, Andy Nugroho Purwohardono, and President Commissioner Ignasius Jonan, though the specific decision-making body is not stated.
Agenda #6: Senior Executive Vice President Yuliana Tjhai submitted the official summary of meeting minutes for PT Soho Global Health Tbk on May 19, 2026.

agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Approval of changes to the Board of Directors composition, including accepting the resignation of Director Piero Brambati effective 31 August 2026, honorably discharging President Director Ery Yunasri, and appointing Harry Salam as President Director and Lucky Setiawan as Director for five-year terms. The resolution passed with 10,333,340,910 approving votes, 0 disapproving, and 0 abstaining.
Agenda #2: Approval of changes to the Board of Commissioners composition, including honorably discharging Independent Commissioner Harry Salam and Commissioner Eng Liang Tan, and appointing Steven Hairul Tjhoea as Independent Commissioner and Ery Yunasri as Commissioner for five-year terms. The new composition, effective 31 August 2026, is President Commissioner and Independent Commissioner Ignasius Jonan, Commissioner Andy Nugroho Purwohardono, Commissioner Ery Yunasri, and Independent Commissioner Steven Hairul Tjhoea, with respective term dates as stated. The resolution passed with the same unanimous vote result.
Agenda #3: Granting power and authority to the Board of Directors, with the right of substitution, to execute all necessary actions for implementing the resolutions from the meeting, including restating in a notarial deed, submitting applications to authorities, notifying the Ministry of Law, and making administrative adjustments, as long as they do not violate laws.
